Name: Crop Stats
Author: HamBandit
Description:
[center]﻿﻿﻿
Crop Stats is a mod that allows you to adjust the stat values of crops.

[u]Crops can have the following stats adjusted:[/u]
- [b]Allowed Seasons[/b]
- [b]Chance to harvest additional crops[/b]
- [b]Growth rate (per Phase)[/b]
- [b]Harvest method (grab or scythe)[/b]
- [b]Maximum harvested[/b]
- [b]Minimum harvested[/b]
- [b]Regrow days[/b]
- [b]Seed description[/b]
- [b]Waterless toggle[/b]

Use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to make editing the crop stats even easier.

Existing Crops are not affected by changes made to their crop type, only crops planted after the changes are made will be affected.

[b]BY DEFAULT, THIS MOD DOES NOT MAKE ANY CHANGES TO ANY CROP STATS![/b]
